protocol: Cross-fitted pitch-local conditional residual support after global unregularized competing-pitch NNLS; all target groups evaluated including globally inactive groups; train-only cutoff and complete-chord gates before held-out/continuous replay.

focused_review.finding: Ridge shrinkage in the competing-note null fit could create false upper support; replaced by unregularized QR/NNLS and verified exact-parent false-upper support remains zero.
focused_review.disposition: Resolved. Candidate-only conditional local addition is explicitly not a local full-refit likelihood ratio.

bulk_policy: Collect small report once with server digest verification; retain bulk remotely.
next: Dispatch this frozen CPU workflow once; collect its small report and apply unchanged train, held-out and corpus safety gates. No retuning or rerun.
limits: Original source/label discrepancies stay included; no alternate label manifest.
Masks use nominal A440 and correlated shared harmonic bins; template mismatch and detuning remain risks.
Conditional residual support is not probability or audibility.
Sustained mixtures do not establish note/string, MIDI lifecycle, native timing or live readiness.
